recipe: Independent pinned Python main(now=...) with fixed UTC clock; strict gh/git executable shims; raw stdout/stderr; only canonical call ordering and temporary-root placeholders. Native CLI uses --now. Repeated cases reuse the same cache and assert no second log downloads.
launcher:
import datetime, importlib.machinery, importlib.util, pathlib, sys
path, now, root, *args = sys.argv[1:]
loader = importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader('frozen_oracle', path)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(importlib.util.spec_from_loader(loader.name, loader))
loader.exec_module(module)
sys.exit(module.main(args, now=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(now.replace('Z', '+00:00')), root=pathlib.Path(root)))
